events.body:
## Context

`CONTRIBUTING.md` clones `github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/BLT-Vanish.git` then `cd BLT-Vanish-Web`, and tells you to run `npm test` / `npm run lint` in `cloudflare_workers`, whose package.json only has `dev`, `deploy` and `check`.

## What to do

1. Clone `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git` and `cd BLT/blt-vanish`.
2. List only commands that exist (`npm run check`, or pytest once the tests issue lands); use `dart run build_runner`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clone path is correct
- [ ] Every listed command exists

## How to test locally

```bash
Run each documented command.
```

---
Size: **S** · good first issue. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
